_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and, being the wider of the two (D7), sizes the one sensor — which is also the audience interaction.ambient fans out to. The pre-merge aggroRadius 1.0 stayed as authored but no longer governs anything: under D21 leaving talk range now ENDS a conversation, and 1.0 leaves less standing room than the two bodies take up (L26). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. ⚑ D23's AMBIENT NPC (chunk 3b-ii) and the one D18 exists for: it calls out as you walk past AND opens a tree on E. Those are two independent fields now — under the retired single-valued `trigger` an actor could only ever do one of them, which is what forced the enum's deletion. Its `ambient` lines are the only ones in the game, so they are also the regression test for walk-by speech; the hint branch (news → news_who) is D23's second required shape. Teaches the base Damage aura and Recall — the closest thing the world has to a starting trainer. ⚑ QUESTS (plan-quests.md C4): the crier OFFERS `wolves-on-the-road` (he already spoke its brief before it existed, in the `news` node) but turns in NOTHING — that is D9's branch, and it is finished east, by either the CityGuard or the Shaman, for different rewards. `wolves_carry` is where the player learns there is a choice at all: written directions, no marker (GDD 8). ⚑ The offer node carries a DIRECT row to `teachings`, and that is not decoration: a quest-conditional greeting sits in front of the unconditional root (L3), and this NPC hands out the player's first ability (Damage @L1) — without that row a brand-new player would reach it three clicks deep, behind a row labelled as a refusal. Quest nodes above root, back-to-root rows on each: see docs/manual-content-authoring.md § Quests.
name: TownCrier

ambient: Wolves on the forest road! Travel armed or not at all!
The militia wants word of every attack — east, to the city!

lines: You there! Good. Somebody who still walks toward trouble instead of away from it.
Wolves. Out of the forest, onto the road, bolder every week. Thin them out and get word east to the militia — that is the whole of it.

grants.line: Eight. Eight and the road is walkable again — then east with the word, and let somebody with a banner decide what it means.

options.text: Who else should I speak to?

lines: Still counting? Then there are still wolves. Come back when there are eight fewer.
Eight fewer on that road. Good. Now the word — east, to the militia at the city gate, and do not dawdle about it.
Though there's a shaman keeps a fire by the road, well short of the gate. He'd want to hear it too, if the whole walk east is more than you fancy.
You there! Good. Somebody who still walks toward trouble instead of away from it.
Wolves. Out of the forest, onto the road, bolder every week.
Thin them out and get word east to the militia. That is the whole of it.

options.text: Who else should I speak to?

lines: The farmer, if you want to eat. The keeper of the fire east of here, if you want to survive the dark.
Neither will thank you for the visit. Go anyway.
I can spare what a newcomer needs. No more than that.

grants.line: You're finally here! We need your help! Wolves prowl the forrests, kill them!

options.blockedLine: Those wolves are a pest, get rid of them!

grants.line: The city needs to hear of these wolf attacks! Take this so you can find your way back.
